title: Mob Bloom
description: A small Vanilla+ mod that not only adds a new engaging way to create mob farms for hostile mobs.
body:
Mob Bloom is a mod that expands upon the concept of Mob farms quite literally. Allowing you to plant Mob Crops that will summon mobs once fertilized with bonemeal. These crops include:

- Zombush: Summons a Zombie (or Husk if the current biome is a desert)
- Skeleshrub: Summons a skeleton (or Bogged and Stray)
- Withered Skeleshrub: Summons a Wither Skeleton
- Burn Blossom: Summons a Blaze
- Breezy Beet: Summons a Breeze
- Creeporchid: Summons a Creeper
- Spidercane: Summons a Spider
- Phantom Pitcher: Summons a Phantom
- Enderbrosia: Summons an Enderman
- Slimestem: Summons a Slime
- Magma Pod: Summons a Magma Cube
- Pigwart: Summons a Piglin
  
These crops can be crafted using any flower, an echo shard, and the corresponding drops of the mob, or items related to the mob! All recipes are unlocked after obtaining an Echo Shard
